column7: F: Why we follow iDempiere exactly. | M: Same model. Same screens. The extras sit beside it.

column3: chapter card 1: a proven data model
column4: F: 久经验证的数据模型。
column5: F: 久经验证的数据模型。iDempiere 里的每个窗口、栏位、流程和单据，都是同一个应用字典里的一行。 | M: 这个字典是经过验证的，所以我们不另起炉灶，而是一行一行地照着它做。
column7: F: A proven data model. Every window, field, process and document in iDempiere is a row in one application dictionary. | M: That dictionary is proven. So we do not invent another one. We follow it, row for row.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT card.dictionary census: legacy | twin counts read live
column5: M: 我们在真正的 iDempiere 和浏览器孪生里，数了一遍字典。 | F: 表、列、栏位、流程和菜单项：逐行一致。 | M: 只有窗口不同：孪生比 iDempiere 多三个。这一项已列入待办。
column7: M: We counted the dictionary in real iDempiere and in the twin. | F: Tables, columns, fields, processes and menu entries: identical, to the row. | M: Only windows differ: three more in the twin than in iDempiere. That one is on our list to close.

column4: F: 一样的外观和操作。
column5: F: 一样的外观和操作，原样照搬。菜单、窗口、标签页、表格和表单，还有工具栏。 | M: 所以没有什么需要重新学。会用 iDempiere 的人，已经会用这个系统。
column7: F: Same look and feel, verbatim. The menu, the windows, the tabs, the grid and form, the toolbar. | M: So there is nothing to learn. Whoever knows iDempiere already knows this.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT live: menu, Sales Order, icon toolbar; witness_toolbar_icons T1-T4
column5: M: 菜单就是 iDempiere 的菜单。我们打开销售订单窗口。 | F: 工具栏也是 iDempiere 的：只有图标，顺序和提示文字都一样。我们把二十五个窗口，对照 iDempiere 自己的数据行和源代码逐一检查，全部一致。 | M: 查找会打开 iDempiere 自己的查找窗口。表格和表单切换，以及带有十四个其他工具的更多菜单，位置都和 iDempiere 一样。
column7: M: The menu is iDempiere's menu. We open the Sales Order window. | F: The toolbar is iDempiere's: icons only, in its order, with its tooltips. We checked twenty five windows against iDempiere's own rows and source, and all agree. | M: Find opens iDempiere's own lookup window. The grid and form toggle, and the more menu with its fourteen further tools, are where iDempiere puts them.

column3: chapter card 3: extras in plugins and pills
column4: F: 扩展功能放在旁边。
column5: F: 我们添加的一切，都不碰 iDempiere 的界面。 | M: 扩展功能放在药丸托盘里，较大的模块则以插件形式加入。
column6: F: The extras stay beside it.
column7: F: Everything we add stays out of iDempiere's screens. | M: Extras live in the pill tray, and bigger modules arrive as plugins.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT live: pill tray (17 pills), Plugin Engine offer (2 bundles)
column5: M: 这是托盘，共十七个药丸：报表、销售点、厨房、仓库巡检、Excel 报表，还有插件引擎。 | F: 插件引擎带有两个插件包，并提示安装。插件包自带窗口和流程，完全不动核心。
column7: M: Here is the tray. Seventeen pills: reports, point of sale, kitchen, warehouse walk, Excel report, and the plugin engine. | F: The engine holds two plugin bundles and offers to install them. A bundle brings its own windows and processes, without touching the core.

column5: M: 同一个字典，同一套界面，同样的习惯。学会一次 iDempiere，就已经会用这个系统。 | F: 完全照它来，就保住了你使用它的权利，而扩展功能也不会碍事。
column7: M: Same dictionary, same screens, same habits. Learn iDempiere once, and you already know this. | F: Following it exactly keeps your right to use it, and the extras never get in the way.
